svg.title: noctcore. Autonomy, governed.
svg.desc: An agent's diff travels toward your branch through lint rules, repo checks and a verification gauntlet. Shell injection stops at the lint rules, a CI job that installs packages while it holds a secret stops at the repo checks, and a skipped test stops at the gauntlet.

g.aria-label: Agents write the code. Every change still passes a gate.
